key_insight: The proposed framework combines ontology-grounded knowledge with multi-agent reasoning to make differential diagnosis more explicit and auditable.
clinical_relevance: It aims to support clinical reasoning by linking diagnostic possibilities to structured evidence and identifying missing information for follow-up.
method: Ground diagnostic inference in an expert-curated medical ontology.
Decompose reasoning into explicit, traceable multi-agent steps.
Identify discriminative missing symptoms and generate targeted follow-up questions.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports publicly available source code but provides no dataset details, evaluation metrics, or quantitative results supporting its claimed improvements.
watch_item: Clinical reliability remains unestablished from the abstract and may depend on the ontology’s coverage and accuracy.
paper_title: Ontology-guided multi-agent reasoning for explainable differential diagnosis
